# Introduction

In the State of New York, car dependency has become an important fact within the work culture for many New Yorkers across the state. The question this project will look at is what is the relationship between car ownership and the employment rate in different parts of the state? Will we find places that have high car ownership also to have greater job opportunities and employment rate?

If so, how can this research be used to help those who don't own a car, still have access to job opportunities across the state? The potential answers to this question could also help explain how car ownership is crucial for working in the modern era today.

The data being used to with in this project can all be found within NY's data. gov website

# Download / Load Required Packages

```{r}
#'install.packages("nysOpenData")
#'installed.packages("tigris")
library("tidyverse")
library("nysOpenData")
library("knitr")
library("sf")
library("tigris")
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

# Download the Data
```{r}
Catalog_NY <- nys_list_datasets()
Catalog_NY[ grepl("County Employment Data", Catalog_NY$title, ignore.case = TRUE), c("key", "uid", "title")] #This code gives us a full catalog of all the datasets available, unfortunately our Employment data cannot be found here so we have to manual find the API Endpoint

NYCountyEmployData <- nys_any_dataset(json_link = "https://data.ny.gov/resource/4v74-29eq.json") #Since we couldn't find the website on the catalog, we use this code with the website API Endpoint to get the dataset


NYVehicleData <- nys_pull_dataset(dataset = "w4pv-hbkt", where = "record_type = 'VEH'") #Since this dataset was found inside the catalog, we don't need API Endpoint. This code also filtered the data to only see Vehicles!

```

# Map / Filter the Vehicle Data
```{r}
NYS_Counties <- counties( state = "NY", cb = TRUE, year = 2024)

NY_CarOwnership_Map <- NYS_Counties %>%
  left_join(NYVehicleData, by = c ("NAMELSAD" = "county"))

ggplot(NY_CarOwnership_Map)+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = COUNTYFP), color ="blue")+
  labs(title = "Car registrations by county in New York State")

```
